name: Repair Armor
description: You magically repair damaged armor or shields. The spell takes 1 minute to cast and removes one level of equipment degradation or restores minor physical damage to worn armor.
effect: Dents knocked out, straps and rivets made whole: +1 AC for 8 hours while you wear armour or carry a shield.
notes: +1 AC for 8 hours, only while you wear armour or a shield.
1-minute casting time in the fiction; cast it in camp before the day's road.
